---
title: "2024-2026_BR_ARKEV"
output: html_document
date: "2026-11-18"
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(googlesheets4)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
br_arkev_all = read_sheet('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ZvPcnTXGdeXDLAd6pAoWIPcONlQlJABzmKBdLYYfByY/edit?gid=0#gid=0')

br_arkev_all <- br_arkev_all %>%
   mutate(stipe_length  = map_dbl(stipe_length,  ~ if (length(.x) == 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(.x[1])),
    kelp_on_ARKEV = map_dbl(kelp_on_ARKEV, ~ if (length(.x) == 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(.x[1])),
    date = as.Date(paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kelp_on_ARKEV)) %>%
  mutate(year = as.character(year))
```
#kelp on arkev
```{r}
br_arkev_kelp_num <- br_arkev_all %>%
  mutate(month_day = as.Date(paste(2024, month, day, sep = "-"))) %>% # pick any reference year
  group_by(year, month_day) %>%
  distinct(year, month_day, ARKEV_unit, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(year, month_day) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(kelp_on_ARKEV))
```

```{r}
ggplot(br_arkev_kelp_num, aes(x = month_day, y = total, color = year, group = year)) +
  geom_point(size=2.5) +
  geom_line(size=1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA)  # starts at 0, automatic upper limit
  ) +
  labs(title = "Total Number of Spliced Sporophytes on ARKEVs", x = "Month", 
       y = "# Spliced Individuals", 
       color = "Year") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) 
```

#Number of Spliced Sporophytes per ARKEV
```{r}
br_arkev_kelp_num_avg <- br_arkev_all %>%
  mutate(month_day = as.Date(paste(2024, month, day, sep = "-"))) %>% # pick any reference year
  group_by(year, month_day) %>%
  distinct(year, month_day, ARKEV_unit, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(year, month_day) %>%
  mutate(avg = mean(kelp_on_ARKEV))
```

```{r}
ggplot(br_arkev_kelp_num_avg, aes(x = month_day, y = avg, color = year, group = year)) +
  geom_point(size=2.5) +
  geom_line(size=1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA)  # starts at 0, automatic upper limit
  ) +
  labs(title = " Number of Spliced Sporophytes per ARKEV", x = "Month", 
       y = "Mean # Spliced Individuals", 
       color = "Year") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

#Growth of spliced sporophytes
```{r}
br_arkev_all_growth <- br_arkev_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(stipe_length)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(days_since_outplanting)) %>%
    mutate(month_day = as.Date(paste(2024, month, day, sep = "-"))) %>% # pick any reference year
   group_by(year, month_day) %>%
  distinct(year, month_day,ARKEV_unit, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(year, month_day) %>%
 summarise(
    mean_stipe_length = mean(stipe_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_stipe_length = sd(stipe_length, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    sd_stipe_length = sd(stipe_length, na.rm =TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
View(br_arkev_all_growth)
```

```{r}
ggplot(br_arkev_all_growth, aes(x = month_day, y = mean_stipe_length, color = year, group = year)) +
  geom_point(size=2.5) +
  geom_line(size=1) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_stipe_length - se_stipe_length, ymax = mean_stipe_length + se_stipe_length),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA)  # starts at 0, automatic upper limit
  ) +
  labs(title = "Growth of Spliced Sporophytes", x = "Month", 
       y = "Mean Stipe Length (cm)", 
       color = "Year") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```
